title: inga laurina
intro: Inga laurina, commonly known as White Apple, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malpighiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Inga laurina include antioxidant, anti-hemorrhagic, and anti-diarrheal effects, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Inga laurina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
